ck_units.why: CK 0.7.0 (bundled JDT) throws NullPointerException in LambdaExpression$LocalTypeSubstitutor when Attr.java and ArgumentAttr.java are resolved together (each alone, and the folder without either one, run fine). Neither is a sample file; ArgumentAttr.java and the three sample files (Annotate, Operators, Resolve) do not reference each other. The sample classes' metrics are identical with ArgumentAttr.java left out.

relational_files.why: javalang 0.13 cannot parse `ClassNode[]::new` (array constructor reference); see relational.py
javalang 0.13 cannot parse a type-use annotation in type arguments (`Map<Integer, @Nullable List<...>>`, line 86)

unresolved_ck_units.affects: 4 function samples (6812825, 6823557, 6824306, 6829907) in InternalN4JSParser.java; no class samples
unresolved_ck_units.why: CK OutOfMemoryError at java_xmx 6g in TightClassCohesion.getIndirectConnections (LCC's method-pair closure). The folder's only Java file is InternalN4JSParser.java (6.37 MB, generated ANTLR parser), so leaving a file out cannot help.
unresolved_ck_units.next: retry this unit alone with a ~12g heap when that much RAM is free (machine has 15.7 GB)
